identification: Golden Fleece SUPRA Heavy Duty Hydraulic Brake Fluid S.A.E. 70-R-3, 1 Imp. Pint rectangular tin, H.C. Sleigh Limited (Australia), c.1950s-60s 'dogbone' era. Yellow over blue, red ram-on-plinth Golden Fleece logo on both faces; second face has the 'guaranteed to meet in its entirety the Society of Automotive Engineers specification SAE 70-R-3' paragraph and 'H.C. SLEIGH LIMITED' on the blue band; side panel also printed H.C. Sleigh Limited. Original-looking screw cap present. Condition: front face fairly bright with grime and a few rust spots; second face has scattered rust pitting/spots (a cluster over the spec text) and paint chips, blue band with rust flecks, rusty base rim. No dents or holes visible. Fair grade, slightly below lot 1462 in the same sale. Estimate 50-90, current bid $30.
